observation.visible_scene: A tight close-up of an electric guitar body (tortoiseshell pickguard, a chrome-covered single-coil pickup stamped 'FENDER PAT PEND', brass bridge saddles, a white control plate with a toggle switch and knob, and a black microphone-stand clamp at the left edge). A player's right hand repeatedly moves over the strings to strum/pick, sometimes holding a small green pick. The framing drifts between the bridge-pickup area and the neck-pickup/control-plate area.
visible_changes: The right hand enters and leaves the frame many times, sweeping across the strings; in several frames (e.g. 1,2,4,7,8,9,10,13,15,19,22,25,29,32,33,35,40) the hand is motion-blurred, indicating fast strumming, while in others (3,14,16,17,21,26,27,30,36,37,41) it is steadier and the green pick is visible gripped between the fingers.

The hand's working position shifts along the guitar: early frames it strums near the bridge pickup, later frames (around 13 onward) it strums nearer the neck pickup and the slanted silver pickup cover.

The camera view changes: the lower control plate with the black switch tip and round knob is absent in the first frames but appears at the bottom from about frame 11 onward, and the visible pickup/bridge layout re-centers, indicating the camera pans/tilts (or repositions) rather than the guitar moving.
Between frames 10 and 11 the hand disappears and the angle drops to show the control plate, then the hand re-enters at frame 13 over the neck pickup.
String vibration is implied by blur and the hand's repeated contact but no single sustained string motion is isolated.
outside_clip_unknowns: The musical context, tempo, and what is played before the first frame or after the last frame.
Whether the framing shifts are smooth camera moves or edited cuts between angles.
The full guitar model and the player's other (fretting) hand, which is never shown.
uncertain_details: Exact strumming pattern and which strings are struck in each pass.
Whether the green pick is used on every stroke or the hand also strums bare.
Precise cause of the view change near frame 11 (camera tilt vs. cut).
